lines: It has 391,305 GitHub stars and runs on any OS.
It solves running AI on your own computer in the chats you already use.
OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant for your local devices that meets you in Discord, Slack, and other chats.
A local Gateway manages your sessions and connects your devices directly to your messaging channels.
You can configure models and authentication in the documentation, then connect a messaging service to your local assistant.
It adds tools, skills, and plugins from ClawHub to run apps on your local devices.
The installer works on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
The OpenClaw Foundation builds it under the MIT license. Amazon and Red Hat fund its development.
Run the install script for your operating system, then run openclaw onboard to finish setup.
Send this to someone who wants local AI on their chats today.
Your assistant, right here in your chats today.
